words.sense: Unconnected with religious institutions, authority, or sacred purposes.
misconceptions: Anything outside a religious institution must deny gods.

words.sense: Expressing or holding disbelief in gods.
words.connotation: may be neutral or contentious depending on context
misconceptions: Disbelief in gods is merely a neutral organizational separation.

semantic_axes.description: Separation from religious authority versus a claim about existence.
Neutral treatment of beliefs versus explicit disbelief.

edges.boundary_rule: Secular means independent of religion, whereas atheistic asserts that gods do not exist.
clues_a: open to any belief but governed without clergy
concerned with everyday rather than sacred matters
irrelevant_clues: being held in a historic building

misconceptions.M1: Anything outside a religious institution must deny gods.
misconceptions.M2: Disbelief in gods is merely a neutral organizational separation.
misconceptions.M3: A person’s beliefs automatically determine an institution’s character.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Priya’s proposed school policy?

beats.text: Priya proposes lessons chosen by teachers, not by any religious organization.
beats.decisive_clue: school curriculum independent of religious authority
beats.reason: The proposal concerns governance of lessons.

beats.text: The policy lets pupils keep their own religious practices outside class.
beats.decisive_clue: allows individual faith while keeping curriculum independent
beats.reason: Allowing personal religious practices confirms neutrality rather than disbelief in gods.

chains.feedback_short: Allowing personal religious practices confirms neutrality rather than disbelief in gods.
chains.feedback_deep: The proposal concerns governance of lessons. Allowing personal religious practices confirms neutrality rather than disbelief in gods. Secular sets religion aside; atheistic denies gods exist.
chains.contrast_rule: Secular sets religion aside; atheistic denies gods exist.

hints.attention: Is the policy about authority or existence?
hints.axis: Separation from religious authority versus a claim about existence.
hints.contrast: Secular sets religion aside; atheistic denies gods exist.
